title: Replicating SAE 'concept crystals' geometry on a fresh open SAE

original_idea.body: Replicating SAE concept-crystal geometry (arXiv:2410.19750) on a fresh publicly released SAE; count validated parallelogram crystals vs random baseline with a significance test. Pure linear algebra, no training.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Bears on whether interpretability-based safety claims generalize, but the chain to catastrophic risk skips steps.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Pure linear algebra on a downloaded SAE, no training; ideal for beginners.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Tightly scoped: count validated crystals vs random baseline with significance test.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Interpretability generalization, public SAEs, weak lab incentive; independent-friendly replication.

low_compute.reasoning: Linear algebra on pre-trained SAE vectors; CPU/free-tier feasible.

novelty.reasoning: Replication of a known result on new SAEs; partly-open generalization question.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Known phenomenon; replication on fresh SAEs is the open part.
